description: This file implements a React component called IngestionClient for a document ingestion UI, including file upload handling, category labeling, uploaded previews display, and a dummy LinkedIn connection toggle. It manages local state for uploaded files and provides UI interactions with animation effects.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte value into a human-readable string with appropriate units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label or 'FILE' if none or filename is uppercase.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random string ID for uploaded previews.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns display label for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns the UI title for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a color code associated with an upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file formats string for input.

methods.name: UploadCard
methods.description: A React component that provides a UI card for uploading files with drag-and-drop and click-to-browse functionality.

methods.name: LinkedInConnect
methods.description: A dummy React component simulating LinkedIn connection toggle.
